text:
alex: FYI we're scheduling a partial index + backfill on profiles(email) tonight in the quiet window 23:30 UTC. This is CONCURRENTLY but backfill is via job-runner. Need deploybot pin, ratecaps, and explicit abort gates. @sam @tasha can you cover ops and rollback?
sam: got it. I'll pin deploybot and create a canary by tenant hash. suggestion: canary 8% -> 50% -> all.
tasha: add aborts: 1) any DDL lock > 3s observed by lockwatch, 2) profiles read p95 > 180ms for 2m straight, 3) backfill job error rate > 0.5% for 5m. also abort if replica lag > 8s. i'll wire a feature-flag kill.
lee: tuning notes: per-tenant concurrency 3, global backfill qps 150, batch size 2k. queue growth >15% for 4m -> throttle to 40 qps.
sam: pin command ready:
```
# pin deploybot to v2024.02-mig for schema ops
deploybot pin release v2024.02-mig --scope schema --until 00:30UTC
```
sam: set ratecap: `rbctl set-ratecap backfill 150`
lee: SQL snippet for runbook (use CONCURRENTLY + batched updates):
```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_profiles_email ON profiles ((lower(email))) WHERE email IS NOT NULL;
-- backfill job example
UPDATE profiles SET email_index = lower(email) WHERE email IS NOT NULL AND email_index IS NULL LIMIT 2000;
```
alex: note: do NOT run full-table UPDATE in one tx. job-runner should checkpoint last_id. add 5-15ms jitter between batches.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: alert rule `profiles_partial_index_lock` created: lock >3s -> page oncall.
deploybot: Deploybot: canary rollout started for 2222223333. Stage: canary-8pct. Image: v2024.02-mig.
lee: monitoring: p95 130ms, errors 0.1%, lag 0.8s. canary looks fine.
deploybot: Deploybot: canary step complete 5 8% tenants migrated. starting 30m observation window.
lee: after 20m metrics steady. expanding to 50% now.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: alert `profiles_partial_index_lock` fired for shard 412: observed lock 4.1s. paging oncall.
tasha: seeing the page. shrinking rollout 5 dropping to canary-8pct and pausing backfill. triggering rollback playbook now.
sam: rollback command:
```
# rollback to stable
deploybot rollback release v2024.02-mig --to stable --reason "lock spike on shard 412"
```
deploybot: Deploybot: rollback acknowledged. Migration jobs paused. Checkpoint saved: last_processed_id=9123412.
lee: confirmed pause. i'll open a stop-the-line PR to reduce batch size to 500 and increase jitter to 20-100ms. also add lock contention metric to canary gate.
alex: good catch. immediate action items: create ticket for backfill tuning, rerun in next maintenance window only after sign-off. i'll draft release-note blurb and the incident note.
tasha: i'll follow up with post-mortem. oncall until 01:15 UTC.
sam: +1. posting release-notes snippet after PM. :white_check_mark:
lee: thanks everyone. saved checkpoints make resume safe.
